summary: Closed REG-231 (kernel/sandbox self-deadlock: two-layer fix, live-verified twice, committed+pushed). Corrected a wrong roadmap-status assessment (all 17 NPDEV_MEGA_ROADMAP sessions actually shipped) and fixed 2 real gaps found while auditing it: S14's missing provenance-index schema, and PACK-23 (Pigmentampas was faking remote-pack consumption with local stand-ins). Fixed CI-coverage/script-inventory/panel-manifest hygiene gaps. Found and recorded (deliberately not triaged) 25 pre-existing untriaged security-pattern hits (SEC-12).
nextStep: Two independent next tasks, pick either -- neither depends on the other. Triage each into docs/SECURITY_PATTERN_SWEEP_2026-07.md as genuine (file a REG-nn)/safe (allowlist fingerprint in scripts/quality/security-pattern-sweep-allowlist.json)/needs-review, then re-run 'python scripts/ai/run_digest.py -- pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/quality/run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1' to confirm 0 untriaged. (2) QUAL-58 guard backlog: 16 ledger items need a real guard: block or reclassification -- full list in ledger/items/QUAL-58.yml (PACK-21/22, REG-211/212, RUN-32/33/34/35/36 have none; REG-213/214/221/223/224/225 have kind:test refs that are prose command lines, not real .java paths, likely need kind:local instead; REG-226's ref is bare 'gradlew' with no resolvable task/class). Verify via 'python scripts/quality/check-done-item-guards.py' after each fix.
plan: D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\roadmap-2026-09-14\NPDEV_MEGA_ROADMAP.md -- all 17 sessions already shipped per 'git log --grep=MEGA_ROADMAP', see memory project_mega_roadmap_status_2026_09_21.md.
